qemu_user_lib_path.description: The prefix path for the ELF interpreter, equivalent to the -L command line argument.

qemu_user_stack_size.description: The stack size in bytes, equivalent to the -s command line argument.

qemu_user_page_size.description: The host page size to set, equivalent to the -p command line argument.

qemu_user_log_options.description: Comma-separated log options to activate debugging output, equivalent to the -d command line argument.

qemu_user_gdb_port.description: TCP port number to wait for a GDB connection, equivalent to the -g command line argument.
